name: The Day After
source:
In The Day After, you will embark on a thrilling journey filled with unexpected twists and turns.
Did your mother died? Did your sister meet the same fate? These are answers that remain unknown.
You believed the world was ordinary, until that fateful night when everything changed…
translation:
在《那日之后》中，你将踏上一场充满意外波折与惊险反转的旅程。
你的母亲是否已经遇难？你的妹妹是否也遭遇了同样的厄运？这些疑问的答案至今仍扑朔迷离。
你曾以为这个世界平凡如常——直到那个改写一切的宿命之夜降临……
